Please use fictional/public example data. Do not upload passwords, API keys, account tokens, personal correspondence or an unredacted data folder.
For a security vulnerability, use [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/teydra/OpenAutark/blob/main/SECURITY.md) instead of this public issue.

### Version and setup
- OS:
- Autark version and download URL (or source commit):
- Model/provider and connection method (no credentials):

### Task
What did you ask the manager to do? Include the exact prompt if it contains no private information.

### What happened
- Were colleague tasks actually created?
- What did each colleague return?
- Did the manager show the result in your chat?
- What did you expect instead?

### Evidence
Optional redacted screenshots, error text and the relevant task/run IDs. Distinguish an observed result from your interpretation.
